<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Press SPACE to switch to blue cross
result = action(['SPACE'])
print(f"After SPACE: game_over={last_action_result.get('game_over')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
white = [n for n in seg if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] <= 2]
my_pos = white[0]['boundary'][0] if white else None
print(f"My position: {my_pos}")

# Find blue cross
blue_shapes = [n for n in seg if n['color'] == 'b' and n['pixels'] > 10]
for s in blue_shapes:
    boundary = s['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    blue_center = (sum(rows) // len(rows), sum(cols) // len(cols))
    print(f"Blue cross center: {blue_center}")

# Check purple bar
lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
bar = lines[63] if len(lines) > 63 else ''
purple_count = sum(1 for ch in bar if ch == 'p')
print(f"Purple bar: {purple_count} cells")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
